text_block_list.text:
One day, I spotted Ikuno Dictus eating a 
meal at the café, but...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ikuno, mind if I join you?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Yes, not a problem at all.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Man~ I've got some intense training right 
after this. So I gotta eat a solid lunch 
to match, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Hm? Something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Please wait here. I will return shortly.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Y-Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for waiting. If you would like, 
please have these as well.

Ikuno Dictus lined up the salads and side 
dishes she brought in front of Nice 
Nature.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: U-Uhh... what's all this?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Lately, I have noticed significant 
nutritional imbalances in your dietary 
habits, Nature-san.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Hmm, now that you mention it... maybe so.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. As a result, you are likely 
deficient in vitamin B1 and protein.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Neglecting the intake of these nutrients 
is said to markedly decrease exercise 
efficiency.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: So, I'll be good if I just eat this stuff?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes. By consuming these side dishes, you 
should be able to supplement your lacking 
nutrients.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
These nutrients are essential if you wish 
to continue your racing career for as long 
as possible, and furthermore—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I'll eat it! I'll gladly eat it all! Come 
on, Ikuno, eat with me!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...Very well. Let us begin our meal.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Phew~ thanks for the food. Somehow, I feel 
totally filled with vitamins.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It should not take effect that quickly. 
Nutrient absorption requires more time—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Alright, alright... it's just a feeling. 
I've never really thought that deeply 
about that stuff before.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Still, how do you even know about my diet, 
Ikuno?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
You are my friend, Nature-san, so whenever 
I see you in the cafeteria, I take note of 
such matters.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I considered approaching you 
with advice several times, but worried it 
might seem overstepping...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
No way, I'm honestly really grateful. 
Truth is, I'm pretty hopeless at 
nutritional management anyway.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, why don't we eat together a few 
times a week from now on?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I kinda want to hear more about that 
vitamin stuff too.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Understood. In that case, please inform me 
of the days of the week convenient and 
inconvenient for you—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, hey, you really don't need to be so 
formal about it!
